files.C:\\Citadel\\README.txt:
ORDERS FROM ASTRO
=================
Read compliance-checklist.txt for the requirements, then evidence-file.txt for what's actually documented. Classify each requirement as compliant or non-compliant.

1. type compliance-checklist.txt
2. type evidence-file.txt
3. classify <requirement> compliant | non-compliant
files.C:\\Citadel\\compliance-checklist.txt:
PHYSICAL SECURITY COMPLIANCE CHECKLIST
------------------------------------------
requirement-vault-log         all vault entries must be logged with identity and timestamp
requirement-footage-retention  camera footage must be retained for at least 90 days
requirement-restricted-mfa     restricted areas require two independent forms of physical access
requirement-visitor-badges     all visitors must wear a visible, dated badge
files.C:\\Citadel\\evidence-file.txt:
EVIDENCE ON FILE
------------------
requirement-vault-log: full entry log exists, identity and timestamp recorded for every entry.
requirement-footage-retention: system currently retains only 30 days of footage.
requirement-restricted-mfa: restricted areas require both a smart card and a biometric scan.
requirement-visitor-badges: badges are issued but do not show a date.

steps.title: Read the checklist and the evidence
steps.body: Astro: "Know the requirement, then check what's actually documented." `type compliance-checklist.txt`, then `type evidence-file.txt`.

steps.title: Audit each requirement against the evidence
steps.body: Astro: "Only what actually matches the requirement counts as compliant." Classify all four requirements.
